financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Exercise of Series B common stock warrants (70,158 shares), gross proceeds. The filing says only 'April 2026', so the date is a placeholder.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In April 2026, Series B common stock warrants were exercised for 70,158 shares of common stock, resulting in gross proceeds of $0.8 million.

warrants.quote: Each Series E common stock warrant has an exercise price of $11.54 per share, is exercisable immediately and expires five years from the date of issuance.
Each pre-funded warrant has an exercise price of $0.0001 per share, is exercisable immediately and will not expire until exercised in full.
